overview_description.description: Esaal is an online platform that enables users to book consultations and communicate with professionals through digital channels. The service supports remote interactions across areas such as healthcare, business, and personal advisory services. It provides scheduling, virtual meeting, and communication tools designed to facilitate online consultations. The platform primarily serves users in the Middle East and Arabic-speaking markets.

about_short_description.short_description: Esaal offers physical health, mental health, and nutrition consultations with health professionals.

product.name: Medical Consultation
product.description: Provides consultations with medical experts across various specialties via video, audio, or text communication.

product.name: Psychological Consultation
product.description: Offers mental health consultations with licensed psychologists and psychiatrists through video, audio, or text sessions.

product.name: Nutrition Consultation
product.description: Provides access to licensed nutritionists and dietitians for dietary and fitness advice via video, audio, or text communication.

product.name: Mental Health Assessments
product.description: Offers online assessments for various mental health conditions to help users understand their psychological state.

product.name: Consultation Packages (Video and Text)
product.description: Bundles of consultation sessions available for purchase, allowing users to schedule multiple video or text consultations with experts.
